status: verified recovered foundation; integrating performance decision recorded in report

integrator_acceptance.scope: Recovered correctness foundation on measured x86-64 host; no parity completion or all-workloads speed claim
integrator_acceptance.reason: Recover reviewed optimizations absent from main while eliminating documented PHP lifetime failures. Exact-source five-configuration, sanitizer, canonical differential and performance gates pass. Same-input cold analysis saves about six seconds and 44.59% instructions versus main, rather than adopting the unsound preserved binaries.
integrator_acceptance.other_concerns: Array timing overlaps same-binary noise; whole-process instruction increases of about 1.3% array, 1.1-1.8% order/ledger corpus, and 3.64% lifecycle are retained. No general speedup is claimed.
integrator_acceptance.acceptance_rule: Accept two bounded independently confirmed timing losses and recorded small instruction losses for this recovered foundation only. No semantic, unsafe, output, memory or failed-test waiver.
integrator_acceptance.architecture_limit: No native ARM64 performance measurement; no new backend lowering or ARM64 speed claim.
integrator_acceptance.historical_v1_exception: Superseded by fresh v3 results; failed earlier variants remain retained and unaccepted.
